steps.title: The image canvas
steps.body: Your layers are drawn here. Scroll to zoom. Drag to rotate or pan; the Rotate and Pan buttons on the toolbar choose which. Double-click to reset the view.

steps.title: Add a data layer
steps.body: New Layer adds data for the time range shown above it. Pick a format at the top of its menu: JPEG 2000 for fast Helioviewer images, FITS (VSO) for calibrated files, or FITS (native) for a mission's own archive. Layers > Open Image Layer opens a file from disk.

steps.title: The layer list
steps.body: Each layer you load gets a row here; the list stays empty until you add one with New Layer. The checkbox shows or hides a layer, and the x removes it. Drag rows to reorder them. Double-click a layer's name to change its dataset.

steps.title: Layer options
steps.body: Select a layer in the list to see its options here (with no layer loaded, this space is empty). Under Display, Color picks the color table. Under Intensity, the two Levels handles set the brightness window.

steps.title: Play the movie
steps.body: Play runs the movie, and the arrows beside it step one frame at a time. Drag the slider to move through time. J, K and L play backward, stop and play forward from anywhere in the window.

steps.title: Timelines
steps.body: This pane plots time series and events against the movie time. Click an empty part of the plot to move the movie to that time. The Timelines button on the toolbar shows or hides the pane.

steps.title: Projection
steps.body: The Projection button opens a palette that changes how the Sun is mapped onto the screen, for example Orthographic or Latitudinal.

steps.title: Record a movie
steps.body: The red dot records the view as a movie; click it again to stop. Under Playback and Recording in the sidebar, choose One loop, Screenshot or Unlimited, and the output size. Files are saved in the Exports folder inside the HFStudio folder in your home folder.

steps.title: Getting help
steps.body: The Help menu in the menu bar holds the Interaction Guide, which lists the mouse and keyboard shortcuts, and the User Manual. Help > Take the Tour runs this tour again.
